freeze: Fix two/three top-ranked legal preferences, policy definitions, four drift schedules, exact fresh cohorts and criteria before first-use. No favorable rank threshold selected after outcome.

policies: full all currently legal cached preferences
quorum2 all legal preferences when at least two eligible
rank_low_conflict2 when >=2 legal cached keys, use two assignments with lowest present-graph neighbor-degree then key
rank_low_conflict3 when >=3 legal cached keys, use three lowest-degree assignments then key
primary: Per regime, paired heldout-seed churn, matching search calls, legal candidate count, used preference count, cache writes, stored key identities and independent exhaustive Hall7 matching.
